name: 25 further employers — complete public boards
description: Twenty-five additional employers screened against the current catalog and a freshly fetched FreeHire company directory, with current name/alias checks. Deterministic full public board reads without country, title, role-count or page-count sampling. Additional language inventories are included where they advertise distinct posting paths. Counts are source records, not a deduplicated vacancy census.
